sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Waste-disposal factors are intended for Scope 3 reporting of end-of-life disposal of different materials.
Except for landfill, the waste figures cover collection and transport to the point of treatment or disposal.
The waste factors do not quantify the environmental impact of alternative waste-management options.
facts.expected_handling: Do not use as decision-analysis metric.

facts.source_fact: The factors are suitable for GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain Scope 3 accounting.
CarbonWARM may be used for comparing waste-management options but its outputs cannot be used as Scope 3 reporting factors.
facts.expected_handling: Keep CarbonWARM decision use separate from accounting.

facts.source_fact: There were no major waste-disposal methodological changes in 2026; changes reflect updated freight factors.
The accounting method does not credit the waste-sending organisation with avoided primary-resource benefits from recycling.
The organisation using recycled material receives the reduced material-procurement impact where recycled material replaces higher-impact primary material.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve benefit allocation to recycled-material user.

facts.source_fact: Waste figures are expressed as kgCO2e per tonne and include the Kyoto basket of greenhouse gases.
Biogenic CO2 is excluded from the reported waste-disposal figures described in the methodology.
